text: APPROVE. The extraction into `JudgeExpressCall` and `ResolveRoute` keeps every early-exit, short-circuit order and lazy-iteration semantic of the original loop, and by my count the new method scores about 11 (the loop in `ExpressAndFastify` is well under that), below the threshold of 15. I did not build or run it, so the build condition rests on reading the code: the `is not var (path, receiver, middle)` pattern assigns the variables after the early return, which compiles, and no unused locals or nullable mismatches are left behind.
